color.name: --bundle-side-panel-bg
color.notes: Calm Review Panel surface; never replace with a captured literal.

color.name: --bundle-sidebar-button-bg
color.notes: Primary summary action and selected tier.

color.name: --bundle-side-panel-divider-color
color.value: existing semantic divider or side-panel border
color.notes: Use for footer separation; retain accessible contrast without making it a dominant border.

color.name: --bundle-side-panel-clear-color
color.notes: Clear remains textual and icon-supported, never color-only.

typography.name: --classic-summary-title-size
typography.notes: Observed in current and target; use existing font family inheritance.

typography.name: --classic-summary-body-size
typography.notes: Minimum ordinary summary copy size; high zoom must reflow.

typography.name: --classic-summary-count-size
typography.notes: Count remains subordinate to title but readable.

spacing.name: --classic-sidebar-panel-padding
spacing.notes: Observed in current and target desktop.

spacing.name: --classic-summary-section-gap
spacing.notes: Content-driven vertical rhythm; do not copy target panel height.

spacing.name: --classic-summary-row-gap
spacing.notes: Current and target use approximately this row/list cadence.

spacing.name: --classic-summary-safe-area-gap
spacing.notes: Required for mobile persistent action edge.

size.name: --classic-summary-action-min-block-size
size.notes: Applies to primary, clear, disclosure, and row actions through appropriate hit areas.

size.name: --classic-desktop-sidebar-min-width
size.notes: Keep intrinsic grid track; never set captured 408px or 414px as a fixed width.

size.name: --classic-summary-thumbnail-size
size.notes: Retains product recognition while allowing text/action space.

size.name: --classic-summary-list-max-block-size
size.value: available dynamic viewport after header, feedback, footer, and safe-area
size.notes: Content-driven calculation; list is the only summary scroll owner.

radius.name: --bundle-side-panel-btn-radius
radius.value: existing merchant value with current Classic fallback
radius.notes: Reuse for panel/button/row aliases where semantically appropriate.

radius.name: --classic-summary-panel-radius-fallback
radius.notes: Current and target desktop surface radius.

radius.name: --classic-summary-row-radius
radius.notes: Rows remain quieter than the outer surface.

border.name: --classic-summary-divider-width
border.notes: True hairline primitive separating review from action.

border.name: --classic-summary-row-border
border.notes: Optional low-chrome containment; remove when surface contrast is sufficient.

shadow.name: --classic-summary-shadow
shadow.notes: Current and target rely on surface contrast, not elevation shadow.

z_index.name: --classic-summary-tray-layer
z_index.notes: Do not introduce a larger arbitrary z-index; preserve modal and theme overlays above the tray.

motion.name: --classic-summary-disclosure-duration
motion.owner: Classic mobile CSS and existing toggle animation owner
motion.notes: Calm but responsive; state and aria update immediately.

motion.name: --classic-summary-reduced-motion-duration
motion.notes: Existing reduced-motion pattern; behavior remains immediate.

breakpoint.name: --classic-summary-desktop-min-width
breakpoint.owner: Classic responsive presentation and responsive layout owner
breakpoint.notes: Approved available-widget-width boundary; test 1023/1024/1025px at a 16px root.

component_alias.name: --classic-summary-footer-layout
component_alias.value: minmax(0, auto) minmax(min-content, 1fr), with stacked fallback
component_alias.notes: Prevents total and CTA collision without fixed captured widths.

component_alias.name: --classic-summary-list-overflow
component_alias.value: auto block-axis; contained overscroll; visible focus
component_alias.notes: Header and action footer remain outside the list scroll owner.

component_alias.name: --classic-summary-state-shift-budget
component_alias.notes: Maximum unapproved boundary shift for stable header/footer regions between equivalent states.

geometry_assertions.expected: Sidebar/tray stays within its allocated component track and viewport.
Primary, disclosure, clear, and effective remove targets are at least 44px in both axes where the control is touch-facing.
Total and CTA never overlap; divider spans the action region.
Only the selected-list region scrolls inside the summary while header and action remain visible.
Component scroll width does not exceed client width at required viewports.
